description: Scaffolds a module with `tgcloud add <target>` (tgcloud/ layout). handlers/<type> is one flat update handler (message, edited_message, callback_query, inline_query, chosen_inline_result, shipping_query, pre_checkout_query, poll, poll_answer, my_chat_member, chat_member, chat_join_request, message_reaction, channel_post, …). endpoints/<name> is a Mini App function (POST /api/<name>; identifier, not starting with a digit). lib/<path> is shared code and may be nested. Existing files are never overwritten.

project_dir.description: Absolute path to a tgcloud project directory (contains .tgcloud/)

target.description: Module path, for example handlers/callback_query, endpoints/getProfile, or lib/cart

name: add_module
title: Add a module
